cards.back: Structured group for profit: fraud, ransomware, data theft and resale.
Actor using violence or coercion for a cause: fear / chaos, ideological motivation.
Low skill level, public scripts and tools; notoriety or curiosity.
Collective motivated by an ideological or political cause; influence and notoriety.
Authorized person with legitimate access: revenge, money, or espionage.
User who makes a mistake without intent: misconfiguration, clicking on phishing.
Economic rival: intellectual property theft and espionage.
Nation-state-backed group, often an APT: espionage, influence, intellectual property.
Monetary gain: fraud, ransom, data resale — typical of organized crime.
Blackmail or ransom: threat of disclosure or destruction.
Gathering secret information; IP = theft of trade secrets or research.
Causing panic and disruption; typical of terrorism or destructive campaigns.
Seeking recognition or exploring without financial gain: profile of the unskilled attacker.
Retaliation against an employer or third party; classic insider motivation.
Acting for a cause, political goal, or unauthorized whistleblowing.
Shaping opinion or behavior, often through disinformation.
Internal = already holds legitimate access; external = must cross the perimeter.
Resources / funding (budget, tools) and sophistication / capability (scripts to zero-days).
